htn_kidney.title: Impact of Adverse Metabolic Factors on the Burden of Chronic Kidney Disease in the Chinese Population ≥ 20 Years Old, 1990-2019.
htn_kidney.authors: Huang J, He Y, Yang F
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：量化 1990-2019 年间中国 20 岁以上成年人因不良代谢危险因素导致的慢性肾脏病 (CKD) 负担的时间趋势。 临床提示：我们使用 2019 年全球疾病负担研究 (GBD 2019) 对中国的估计来评估 5 种 CKD 原因（1 型糖尿病、2 型糖尿病、高血压、肾小球肾炎和其他/未明确原因引起的 CKD）和 3 种原因。
htn_kidney.abstract: To quantify temporal trends in chronic kidney disease (CKD) burden attributable to adverse metabolic risk factors among Chinese adults aged ≥ 20 years during 1990-2019. We used Global Burden of Disease Study 2019 (GBD 2019) estimates for China to assess five CKD causes (CKD due to type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, hypertension, glomerulonephritis, and other/unspecified causes) and three metabolic risks (high systolic blood pressure (SBP), high body mass index (BMI), and high fasting plasma glucose (HFPG)). portal_hypertension.title: Paracentesis exceeding three liters increases risks of acute kidney injury even in cirrhotic patients with albumin infused refractory ascites.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of the Formosan Medical Association = Taiwan yi zhi
portal_hypertension.authors: Wu PS, Lee KC, Li CY
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 116）。核心观点：对于顽固性腹水进行中等量腹腔穿刺术（<5 L）相关的风险仍不清楚。 临床提示：患有难治性腹水的肝硬化患者表现出严重的门静脉高压和血流动力学紊乱。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Cirrhotic patients with refractory ascites exhibit severe portal hypertension and hemodynamic disturbances. The risks associated modest-volume paracentesis (<5 L) for refractory ascites remains unclear. We aimed to explore the impact of modest-volume paracentesis in refractory ascites. Cirrhotic patients with refractory ascites undergoing paracentesis <5 L with albumin infusion were retrospectively enrolled. Patients were categorized into two groups based on the volume of paracentesis: ≥3 L and <3 L. portal_hypertension.title: Porto-sinusoidal Vascular Disease is Associated with Gastrointestinal Disorders in Common Variable Immunodefiency.
portal_hypertension.authors: Corvilain E, Gérard L, Fadlallah J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：门窦血管疾病与常见变异性免疫缺陷中的胃肠道疾病相关。

portal_hypertension.title: Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt Before Extrahepatic Abdominal Surgery: A Systematic Review and Novel Application Following Source-Control Laparotomy.
portal_hypertension.authors: Doran ML, Scarboro DB, Nussbaum MS
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 241）。核心观点：接受肝外腹部手术的肝硬化患者面临门静脉高压的高发病率和死亡率。 临床提示：经颈静脉肝内门体分流术 (TIPS) 在优化手术结果方面的作用仍不确定，特别是在紧急情况下。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with cirrhosis undergoing extrahepatic abdominal operations face high morbidity and mortality from portal hypertension. The role of transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunts (TIPS) in optimizing surgical outcomes remains uncertain, particularly in emergent settings. We present a case and systematic review of studies from 2000-2025 evaluating preoperative, perioperative, and emergent TIPS in patients undergoing extrahepatic abdominal operations.
